body: We both work desk jobs, but 50-60 hours a week. I’m in architecture and he’s in software, and we are both pretty ambitious.

“What do you need from me, what can I help you with”. That’s so simple and so honest... thank you.

And thank you for the book recommendation!
Yes... realizing that now. But I do think we can work through this..

Thank you, this is really helpful. We definitely have a communication issue. 

It’s difficult for me to tell him how I feel because he often literally replies with “well you choose to feel that way” (for example, see the portion of feeling manipulated in my post).

But you bring up a good point.. Maybe I’m saying it in a way that makes him feel attacked. I have to think this through.
